title: Kim Bunlar?
author: Mahir Ünsal Eriş & Töre Sivrioğlu
description: Who Are These People? 23 Fascinating Figures From History proves that history is anything but boring. Far from solemn rulers sitting on their thrones, this book introduces readers to some of the most surprising, daring, and eccentric characters the world has ever known—from emperors with strange obsessions to fearless commanders, powerful female pharaohs, and spies in disguise.
english_title: Who Are These People? 23 Remarkable Figures From History
